类 ProgressFormat

java.lang.Object
cn.msscn.progress.ProgressFormat
public final class ProgressFormat extends Object
Template based text renderer.

Supported placeholders: {index}, {count}, {name}, {bar}, {percent}, {value}, {total}, {unit}, {status}, {speed}, {eta}, {elapsed}. Unknown placeholders are resolved from caller-supplied "extras"; anything still unknown is left untouched so typos are visible.

      public static String format(String template, ProgressSnapshot snapshot, ProgressStyle style, int width, int decimals, String unit)
      Renders with explicit settings and no custom placeholders.
      参数:
      template - the render template
      snapshot - the state to render
      style - the character set used for the bar
      width - bar width in characters
      decimals - percent precision
      unit - the unit appended to numeric values
